correctness.rationale: The full RESULT.md gives the common 2-skeleton argument, a spanning-tree contractible subcomplex and integral relative 3-chain telescoping proving H_2(BI_3)=0 (not merely mod-two vanishing). For triangle/5-cycle-free M_{2n}, n>=5, the exact BI_3 face vector is (2n, C(2n,2), 6n(n-2), C(3n,2)-7n), dimension 3. Reduced Euler rank is 1+C(n+1,2). The 2-connected three-dimensional CW complex has free H_3; Hurewicz/Whitehead give its 3-sphere wedge. Alexander duality shifts degree to 2n-6, and the dual has complete 2-skeleton by max-degree-three greedy bound for n>=6, or bipartite n=5; resulting simply connected complex with one free reduced homology group is the claimed sphere wedge. Separately recomputed full GF(2) boundary ranks for n=5,6,7: reduced Betti_3=16,22,29 respectively; finite ranks do not prove the all-n theorem. Checked 4-cycle correction in f_3 and degree-bound endpoints.
residual_risks: Uniform higher-connectivity theorem relies on the explicit integral relative-chain telescoping; it was checked mathematically rather than formally verified.
Finite GF(2) checks cannot establish integral torsion-freeness for untested n; that comes from the dimension/connectivity argument.
